observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: indoor stage performance with a lit backdrop and theatrical lighting
observation.dancers: mixed group of children and adults, roughly a dozen dancers
observation.formation_and_space: group spread across the stage, shifting between lines, pairs, and scattered formations
observation.posture: upright with upright torso, soft knees, and upright weight placement
observation.footwork: energetic stepping on the beat with kicks, hops, and fast weight shifts; exact foot placement cannot be seen
observation.arms_and_hands: arms move actively with expressive gestures, sometimes extended or holding hands in pairs
observation.hips_and_torso: bounces and side-to-side movements with torso engagement
observation.partnering: intermittent pairing and hand-holding without continuous close contact
observation.levels_jumps_turns: frequent high kicks, occasional jumps, and turns on the spot
observation.costume_and_props: silver shiny tops, shorts or pants, and white boots; no hand props
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement and rapid weight transfers are obscured by camera angles and distance

signature_moments.what: dancers step side to side with synchronized arm and leg movements
dancers perform synchronized high kicks while extending arms to the side
group drops into a low stance while bouncing shoulders and arms
